## Objective
- Build a genuinely playable 3D Tunisia free-ride driving and motorcycle prototype, beginning with a Tunis-area city, a Kawasaki Z750, and one car.

## Requirements
- Single-player offline free ride, designed for mobile with a 30 FPS target.
- Include Tunisian roads, traffic, city details, GPS/map, cameras, vehicle selection, tuning, settings, and driving controls.
- The full vision includes Tunisia’s 24 governorates and an extensive vehicle roster; start with a small playable prototype.
- Do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based Three.js prototype with procedural city and vehicle geometry.
- Prototype setting is a fictionalized La Marsa/Tunis coastal area; the car is a Volkswagen Golf 7.
- Support keyboard controls on desktop and on-screen controls for touch.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` and `style.css` with responsive HUD, menus, vehicle picker, map, garage, settings, and touch controls.
- Built `game.js` with procedural roads, buildings, roadside details, traffic, pedestrians, bike and car models, driving, cameras, vehicle switching, tuning UI, map UI, clock, collision damage, and synthesized engine audio.
- Fixed touch throttle/brake state handling in `update()` to combine keyboard and touch input without resetting held touch controls.
- Added an inline favicon to `index.html`; `node --check game.js` passed after the latest input-control change.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright loaded the app and a viewport screenshot was saved.

### Active
- Reload and test keyboard/touch controls plus vehicle, garage, map, and settings menus after the latest input fix.
- Capture and inspect an updated screenshot; check browser console for runtime errors.

### Blocked
- Full 24-governorate world and extensive vehicle catalog remain outside the current prototype.
- The earlier browser run showed roughly 25 FPS in the test environment; mid-range mobile performance has not been established.

## Next Move
1. Reload the page and test keyboard and touch throttle/brake behavior.
2. Exercise vehicle selection, garage, map, and settings; inspect browser console.
3. Save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot, then address any runtime or visible issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, procedural environment and vehicles, gameplay, controls, and menus.
- `index.html`: App structure, HUD, controls, and inline favicon.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual styling and overlays.
- `screenshots/ride-check.jpg`: Previous browser viewport screenshot; predates the latest touch-input fix.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The previous browser console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico`; an inline data-URI favicon has since been added but not browser-verified.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.166.1/build/three.module.js`.
